title: Inverse Hessian Curvature Flow in Minkowski Space II: The Dirichlet problem at infinity
summary: This paper studies self-shrinkers and the long-time behavior of the inverse $σ_k$ curvature flow for noncompact entire spacelike strictly convex hypersurfaces in Minkowski space. In contrast to the co-compact setting, where the corresponding self-shrinker is rigid, the noncompact problem admits a rich family of self-shrinkers determined by their asymptotic data.
